sam-sales: Heads-up: ZenithHealth wants a 3-week technical POC starting Mar 4. Core ask: SAML SSO (encrypted assertions), SCIM push provisioning with groups->roles mapping, tenant-scoped RBAC, strict domain verification for signups, and option for customer-managed keys. They also want audit forwarding into Splunk. Can we run this on Hosted for the trial or should we recommend Dedicated/Private? cc @noah-se @ravi-eng @elaine-sec

noah-se: Quick clarifying Qs: are SCIM group memberships mapped 1:1 to roles or do they expect role composition? also: do they need nested group support? For SAML: get their IdP metadata (entityID, ACS URL, x509 cert, encryption cert).

ravi-eng: Engineering notes:
- SCIM endpoints: /scim/v2/Users, /scim/v2/Groups; support POST, PATCH (RFC7644), GET.
- We support group nesting but it flattens at evaluation time unless they want hierarchical roles — need mapping rules.
- Rate limits for Hosted POC: recommend <120 SCIM ops/min. We can bump on Dedicated.
- SAML: accept full metadata XML or manual. Encrypted assertions supported but requires their encryption cert.
- BYOK: Private deployments support KMIP/HSM or cloud KMS integrations. Hosted uses our KMS and supports envelope encryption only.

elaine-sec: Security rundown to flag to Zenith:
- We can provide SOC2 Type II and penetration test summary.
- FedRAMP/IL5 not offered on Hosted. Private might meet their higher regs with additional work.
- If they require customer-managed keys (CMK) or no-data-exit guarantees, mark Private as required.
- For Splunk ingest we support HTTPS endpoint with token or syslog over TLS. Need their endpoint + retention/pseudonymization needs.

sam-sales: Zenith replied: they want push SCIM, groups->roles mapping (no nested groups), encrypted SAML assertions, and Splunk HTTP collector. Procurement asked for a rough POC cost + delta to Dedicated.

noah-se: Ballpark for planning (not a formal quote):
- Hosted POC: we usually provide credits + usage billing. For ~2k API calls/day (chat + embeddings), expect token spend roughly $150
$450/month depending on prompts.
- Dedicated entry: small reserved pool (1-2 GPUs) typically at $3k
$7k/month depending on instance type and region.
- Private: license + infra + SE time; varies widely.

ravi-eng: Implementation checklist to attach to kickoff:
- Get IdP metadata (metadata.xml) and encryption cert.
- Provide SCIM token and push URL if they want to push; sample curl below for our SCIM create:
```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/scim/v2/Users" -H "Authorization: Bearer <SCIM_TOKEN>" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"userName":"j.doe@zenithhealth.com","externalId":"zh-9876","name":{"givenName":"John","familyName":"Doe"},"groups":[{"value":"nurse","display":"Nurse"}]}'
```
- Example role mapping template: `group.display -> redwood.role` (e.g., "nurse" -> "patient_viewer").
- Confirm audit events: auth.success, auth.failure, scim.create, scim.update, role.change.

elaine-sec: Also ask: do they require SAML NameID transient vs persistent? any PII restrictions on SAML assertions stored in logs? We'll recommend encrypting assertions in transit and at rest; for Hosted we retain assertion metadata for troubleshooting but redact PII unless they request raw logs via Private.

sam-sales: Next steps: I'll schedule kickoff Wed 10am PST with Zenith technical team + SE + Security. I'll attach the SCIM mapping template and sample SAML metadata request. Ravi, can you prep a short doc on rate limits and SCIM best practices? Elaine, please draft the security questionnaire answers and a one-pager on when Private is required vs Hosted.

infra-bot: Tentative: "zenith-poc-dedicated-hold" calendar hold created for 2025-03-04 08:00 UTC. React :white_check_mark: to confirm.

noah-se: I'll run a brief POC config script during kickoff to show SCIM push + SAML handshake. Also include instructions for Splunk HTTP collector (sample event format).

ravi-eng: I'll prepare the SCIM mapping template and a sample group->role CSV for them to fill out.

elaine-sec: I'll prepare the security pack and a short note: "If CMK required or FedRAMP-level compliance requested, escalate to Solutions Eng for Private deployment scoping."

sam-sales: Great. I'll post Zenith's SCIM mapping here once they send it. Thanks all :rocket:
